name: framework-references-net4x-no-facades
body: ReferenceResolver.ResolveFrameworkReferences loads only the top-level .NETFramework/v4.x reference assemblies for a net4x project, not the Facades/ subfolder, so a net4x project that uses netstandard-based packages may leave types such as those forwarded through netstandard.dll unresolved. Upgrade by adding the Facades/ dlls when net4x scans show such unresolved types.
